  function getUrlParam(name) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    return parseInt(params.get(name) || "0", 10);
  }

  // ====== Helper to create separator ======
  function addSeparatorIfNeeded(nav) {
    if (nav.childNodes.length > 0) {
      nav.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" | "));
    }
  }

  // ====== Current offset ======
  const start = getUrlParam("start");

  const items = document.querySelectorAll("article").length;

  // ====== Build navigation ======
  const nav = document.createElement("nav");

  // Previous page link
  if (start > 0) {
    const prevStart = Math.max(0, start - itemsPerPage);

    const prevLink = document.createElement("a");
    prevLink.style = "font-family: Pretendard; font-size: 16px; color: #666666; text-decoration: none;";
    prevLink.href = `?start=${prevStart}`;

    prevArrow.textContent = "←";
